motion.phase3: No Rive/Lottie dependency. Web uses CSS transforms; app uses built-in React Native/Expo animation primitives where needed.
motion.future: Rive/Lottie only after explicit design + cost review.

loading.app: Bundle only core state assets used by product screens. Extended expressions/poses remain design/social assets and should not be imported into the app bundle.
loading.web: Serve static assets and lazy-load non-critical character art.
loading.social: Keep social/meme assets outside production app bundle.

platform_decision.scope: Assets are cross-platform for Web + App.
platform_decision.rollout: App-first because Aurora v8 is currently app-scoped; Web may reuse the same transparent assets without adopting the App visual theme.
platform_decision.motion_phase3: No new Rive/Lottie dependency. Use static assets + CSS on Web; use built-in React Native/Expo animation primitives on App if a tiny transform is needed.
platform_decision.future_motion: Rive/Lottie requires a separate design/cost review before adoption.
